visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two athletic men are positioned on the red dirt of a baseball field. The man on the left, acting as a coach, wears a dark navy long-sleeved shirt with white athletic pants and a blue cap. He maintains an upright posture while rhythmically tossing baseballs toward the man on the right. The second man, the catcher, is dressed in a bright blue t-shirt and black pants, equipped with a blue batting helmet and black catcher's shin guards. He performs rapid catching motions, alternating between bare hands and a glove. The background is an expansive outdoor stadium with tiers of green and blue seating, large scoreboard structures, and multi-story buildings under an overcast but bright sky. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of a man who was previously coaching. He is wearing a grey zip-up jacket with a small white logo on the chest and a navy baseball cap with orange sunglasses perched on the brim. He stands centrally in the frame against the backdrop of the baseball stadium's outfield and stands. His face is expressive as he speaks, and his hands are frequently used to gesture, palms up and moving inwards to illustrate a point. The lighting remains bright and natural, suggesting an outdoor setting during the day. The camera is steady, focusing on his upper body and head while he articulates his explanation.
